citation: Thorning TK, et al. Potato Fibers Have Positive Effects on Subjective Appetite Sensations in Healthy Men, but Not on Fecal Fat Excretion. Nutrients 2020.
protocol: Overnight fast; breakfast test meal of about 2000 kJ with a wheat bun (about 80% energy carbohydrate; composition in Table 2); blood at 0, 15, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180 min after the 21-day diet
population: n=18 healthy men, age 26 y, BMI 23.2
note: Three-hour glucose and insulin curves with a printed breakfast, but the numbers may be only in figures and in the text for differences at 180 min.
